Step: 1091 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
From 04-23: April has 30 days → 7 days left in April (23 to 30 inclusive is 8 days? Actually: 23→30: 30-23=7 days, but adding 1 day lands on 24th, so careful).  
Better: 43 days after April 23.  
Days left in April after April 23: 30 - 23 = 7 days (April 24 to 30 = 7 days).  
43 - 7 = 36 days into May.  
May has 31 days → 36 - 31 = 5 days into June.  
So June 5, 1091.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1091-06-05
